The '''Defoliator Deployment Tank''', also simply called the '''DDT''', was a medium-sized [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] [[Tank/Legends|tank]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to transport the weapon known as the [[Defoliator/Legends|Defoliator]]. These vehicles saw service during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
[[File:Defoliator.png|thumb|left|200px|The cannon attached to the rear of the DDT.]]
The DDT was designed by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]]. A modified version of the [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AAT]], the Defoliator's main weapon was merged with the modified chassis of an AAT, the larger cannon replaced the traditional turret.

It was a manually loaded single shot cannon, where loading the cannon would tilt it back to allow a shell to be loaded into the open breach. The weapon fired large explosive capsules that would spread fire over a great distance when they hit their target. The flames would turn everything organic in their path to ash, but [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and machinery were immune to it.

==History==
The DDT was first tested on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] by its creator, General Lok Durd. After landing on the colony world of the [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmens]], the general claimed the planet in the name of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. Later that day, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] stranded on the planet observed the enemy testing the weapon.

After coming to the conclusion that the Lurmen people were not intelligent enough to worry about, Lok Durd gave the order to destroy the village with the new weapon. After a small [[Defense of Maridun/Legends|battle]] between the Jedi, Lurmen and droids, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] managed to destroy the weapon.

The [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]], General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], made use of the DDT later in the war during the [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|Battle of Dathomir]].
